title: A refinement of the strange duality conjecture on K3 surfaces
summary: Let $v,w$ be primitive Mukai vectors of positive rank on a polarized K3 surface with $χ(v\otimes w)=0$. Marian and Oprea conjectured that the strange duality map $H^0(M(v),Θ_w)^\vee\to H^0(M(w),Θ_v)$ is either zero or an isomorphism. We give three families of counterexamples to this conjecture. In each of them the map is nonzero but fails to be an isomorphism: in the first (a quartic surface) it is not surjective; in the second (Picard rank one, including very general polarized K3 surfaces) the source has strictly larger dimension than the target; and in the third (an elliptic surface)…
